description: Where the agent may use the content. ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes are implicitly valid without a registry entry. This file defines only the special non-ISO values used in licensing.
conformance: ISO 3166-1:2020 (https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) is the authority for alpha-2 codes. All ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes (US, DE, GB, FR, CN, JP, etc.) are valid geography tokens without needing a registry entry here. The linter does not warn on well-formed two-letter uppercase codes.

tokens.notes: A term with permitted:["*"] is available globally. A Biscuit carrying dist:* covers all dist: scopes. When prohibited contains *, no use is permitted anywhere (use REFERENCE_ONLY instead for terms with no geographic availability).

tokens.description: The European Union — all current EU member states.
tokens.notes: Not an ISO-3166-1 code. Covers the current 27 EU member states as a group. EU membership changes over time; prefer explicit country codes when precise control over included states is required. Relevant for GDPR-scoped licensing and EU DSM copyright.

tokens.description: The European Economic Area — EU member states plus Norway (NO), Iceland (IS), and Liechtenstein (LI).
tokens.notes: Not an ISO-3166-1 code. Relevant for EEA-scoped GDPR compliance and licensing agreements that extend EU terms to EEA members.
